Nia: quick sync - two pilots reported unclear per-route billing during onboarding. both paused testing.
Omar: got a support thread from AlderTech saying they couldn't reconcile test runs with billing lines.
Priya: exact quote? helps escalate.
Nia: AlderTech: "We ran 3 routes and saw one invoice line. No idea which route cost what."
Victor: pattern = discoverability + missing cost-preview. high churn risk for trial accounts.
Priya: suggested first steps: 1) small console banner linking to checklist 2) one-page cost-preview mock 3) docs example mapping requests -> invoice.
Omar: I'll file a ticket and tag product. Priya can own the mock.
Priya: will draft mock (2 slides) and checklist by Fri. Victor will pull session recordings.
OpsBot: ticket created CS-8712 "Onboarding: per-route billing discoverability" assigned Omar. https://redwood.example/issue/CS-8712
Nia: please paste any additional customer quotes into CS-8712. we'll triage next weekday sync. :thumbsup:
